word:islam.title: Submission (Islam)
word:islam.note: Islam is submission, and a muslim one who submits. The Quran uses the word of Abraham (3:67), of the disciples of Jesus (3:52) and of Pharaoh's magicians (7:126) as well as of Muhammad's followers. The same root gives "peace".

entries.text: aslama (أَسْلَمَ): to submit. 22 times in 19 verses.
muslim (مُسْلِم): one who submits. 39 times in 39 verses.
muslima (مُسْلِمَة): a woman, or a people, who submits. 3 times in 3 verses.

word:intercession.title: Intercession
word:intercession.note: No one intercedes with God "except with His permission" (2:255). The idols are called intercessors by those who serve them (10:18).

entries.text: shafaʿa (يَشْفَعُ): to intercede. 5 times in 4 verses.
